To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the benefits of TMT nationality diversification for MNCs’ innovation performance are only realized in MNCs operating in environments characterized as low in power distance and when TMTs exhibit low social stratification.

MNCs that engage in corporate entrepreneurship by sourcing knowledge from diverse sources have higher innovation performance but only if their TMTs are diverse and operate in low power distance environments.

the effects of TMT diversity on corporate entrepreneurship, and subsequently, on innovation performance, are contingent on the degree to which the home country of the MNC has a high power distance culture and the degree of TMT social stratification.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how the nationality diversity of top management teams in multinational corporations affects corporate entrepreneurship and innovation performance.
the role of top management teams (i.e., the CEO and his/her direct reports) in spurring innovation in the multinational corporation.
how the diversity of the upper echelons of multinational firms affects the firm's innovation performance.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the positive effects on innovation of TMTs with diverse nationality are only unleashed when TMTs are characterized by low social stratification in MNCs based on home countries with a low level of national power distance.

the positive effects that TMT nationality diversity has on corporate entrepreneurship and subsequent innovation performance are only unleashed in MNCs where TMTs operate in an environment characterized by equal distribution and low hierarchy.
MNCs benefit from diverse TMTs in terms of innovation performance but only if the environment in which these MNCs operate is characterized by equal distribution in power and low hierarchy.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
MNCs should be aware of how the composition of TMTs can affect corporate entrepreneurship and innovation.
MNCs should strive to have TMTs with a mix of nationalities to enhance innovation.
the benefits of diversity in TMTs can be unleashed when the social structure in the TMTs is low and when the home country of the MNC has low power distance.
The main takeaway from our work is that

MNCs can increase their innovation performance by creating TMTs that are diverse in nationalities, but this will only pay off when TMTs are composed of individuals that are equal and low in hierarchical thinking.
MNCs can benefit from TMT diversity in terms of innovation performance but only if the TMT operates in a culture characterized by equal distribution power and low hierarchy.
MNCs that want to leverage their diverse TMTs to innovate must ensure that the TMT is composed of executives that are willing to engage in corporate entrepreneurship.
